domain.description: The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the Active Directory domain (e.g., 'example.com').

domain_controller.description: Optional hostname of a specific domain controller to use (e.g., 'dc1.example.com'). If empty, adcli will use DNS SRV records to discover controllers.

domain_realm.description: Optional alternate realm name (usually same as domain). If not set, defaults to uppercased domain.

domain_short.description: NetBIOS-style short domain name (e.g., 'EXAMPLE'). Required if joining with legacy Kerberos (e.g., pre-Windows 2008 R2 DCs).

computer_ou.description: LDAP distinguished name (DN) of the organizational unit (OU) where the computer account will be created (e.g., 'OU=Workstations,DC=example,DC=com'). If empty, uses the default OU.

krb5_realm.description: Kerberos realm name (typically uppercase domain). If not set, derived from 'domain'.

adcli_user.description: Pre-registered computer account name (UPN or SAM account) to use for join operations (e.g., 'join-user@EXAMPLE.COM'). If empty, the default 'HOSTNAME$' account is created.

join_type.description: Type of account to create: 'computer' (default) or 'server'. Some AD environments distinguish between these.

join_password.description: Password for the joining user account (used only if 'adcli_user' is specified). Prefer using keytab instead for security.

keytab_file.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file used for authentication (e.g., for unattended joins). If empty, interactive authentication is used.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output for debugging. Set to true to see detailed logs during join.

dns_ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) in seconds for DNS records (e.g., A, PTR) created for the host in AD-integrated DNS zones.

disable_dns_update.description: If true, skip automatic DNS A/Ptr record registration. Useful in environments where DNS is managed externally.

use_fqdn.description: If true, use fully qualified hostnames (e.g., 'host.example.com'). If false, use short hostname (e.g., 'host').

ca_cert_file.description: Path to a CA certificate file (PEM format) used to verify LDAPS connections. Required if connecting to AD over LDAPS with self-signed certificates.

ldaps_servers.description: List of LDAPS server hostnames to prefer over DNS discovery. Each item must include hostname and optionally port (e.g., 'ldaps://dc1.example.com:636').

hostname.description: FQDN or IP address of the LDAPS server.

port.description: LDAPS port (default: 636). Set to 0 to skip port (uses default).
